title: Chapter 284 Ranked 10Th On The Martial Ranking
content:
Chapter 284 Ranked 10Th On The Martial Ranking

Jordanyang, who had eaten a nasty nose, was stunned.

After all, I am also a top alchemist in the fairyland and even the entire fairyland.

I am indeed not as good as Shi Liantian, but I am not that bad.

"I said little girl, do you know what respecting the elderly and loving the young means?"

Jordanyang no longer discussed the alchemy, but focused on Yuanyuan's attitude towards himself.

Hearing this, Yuanyuan's movements stopped immediately.

Yuanyuan turned around, walked straight to Jordanyang, and stomped on Jordanyang's feet with a sudden kick.

The next moment, there was a whistle.

Jordanyang screamed in the yard with his feet in his arms.

"If you don't get out, don't blame me for being rude!"

Yuanyuan said with a cold face.

Although she looks quiet and quiet, don’t forget that she is Shi Liantian’s apprentice.

With Shi Liantian's temperament, would his disciple be so easy to bully?

"You, you,"

Jordanyang's body was trembling, pointing at Yuanyuan, unable to say a word.

I can't beat it, but I can't say it.

In the end, Jordan Yang left Zhuyun Peak with no results.

"Oh, I'm so old."

The sighs spread farther and farther, until they disappeared at the end of Zhuyun Peak.

In Zhuyun Peak, when Jordan left in the sunny direction, there was no slight wave in Yuanyuan's heart, and he was still immersed in his own alchemy.

Over the past ten years, in addition to practicing and practicing alchemy, her realm has also reached the early stage of the Immortal Saint Realm.

I don't know how long it took.

The alchemy furnace in front of me floated out of a refreshing fragrance of medicine, which was extremely rich.

When you open the alchemy furnace, four crystal clear pills, the size of fingernails, are caught in your eyes.

Yuanyuan took out the pill, put it on the tip of her nose, and sniffed it slightly.

After a moment of silence, another pill suddenly appeared in Yuanyuan's hand.

This is an orange pill, several times larger than the pill I made, but there was no scent of it. If I hadn't put it on the tip of my nose and smell it, I might have thought it was just a simple bead.

This pill was given to her by Lu Xue.

When she got the pill, she was silent for a long time.

Above the Emperor’s rank!

And it's nine lines!

Compared with this pill, the pill I refined myself is equivalent to comparing it with stones and gold.

At that time, she understood.

Lu Xue doesn’t lack pills at all. All she needs is a partner she can trust.

Just like Ao Qing.

Her current idea is to rely on her own abilities to help Lu Xue.

Looking at the foot of the mountain for a long time, the round body disappeared into Zhuyun Peak.

......

"Ah? Are you leaving the academy?"

In front of the martial arts list, Qin Feng and the others looked at Yuanyuan in front of them in shock.

This is a top alchemist, and Lu Xue personally brought it out of the deserted city.

Such an old figure actually wanted to leave them.

"I'm not leaving Sister Xue, I just want to experience it outside. After all, it's not that time yet."

Hearing this, the two of them breathed a sigh of relief.

"Then, don't you wait for Sister Xue to come out before leaving?"

Qin Feng looked at Yuanyuan.

Xiao Luo also nodded, "Yes, say goodbye, don't worry about this time."

Upon hearing this, Yuanyuan shook her head.

"No, I think Sister Xue will definitely understand what I mean."

Yuanyuan finally looked up at Wuta and finally left the academy.

"Oh, I didn't expect that Miss Yuanyuan was so decisive."

Looking at Yuanyuan's leaving back, Qin Feng sighed inexplicably.

Xiao Luo, who was standing beside him, didn't say anything, but he was also staring at the distance.

At the same time, Lu Xue's ranking has reached tenth place.

“The top ten!”

One person exclaimed, breaking the silence of the square.

Everyone was inexplicably excited when they saw Lu Xue rushing from one hundred to tenth place, and it seemed that she could not stop at all.

After all, this is also the genius of their Tiandi Academy.

In this world where heroes are rising, their academy must join forces.

After all, in the fairy world now, it is not only their academy that has monsters.

In addition to the evil list, there will definitely be many six people who have the strength of the evil list but have not made it.

Just when everyone thought Lu Xue would immediately hit the noun again, and even reached the previous few days, there was a fluctuation in space.

A flash of light.

The next moment, Lu Xue's figure appeared in front of the martial tower.

"Um?!"

"Damn, what's going on?"

When everyone saw Lu Xue, they were stunned.

Lu Xue actually came out. Judging from this trend, shouldn’t it be the first few? More importantly, isn’t it only possible to teleport out in the martial arts tower?

Judging from Lu Xue's appearance, it seems that there is nothing wrong except for her slightly dirty clothes.

This doesn't look like a defeat.

"Little Master!"

"Sister Xue, are you?"

At this time, Ao Qing and Qin Feng rushed over and came to Lu Xue.

Except Ao Qing, the others were all surprised and confused.

After glanced at everyone present, Lu Xue smiled slightly, "Tenth place, not bad."

not bad. .

Everyone was speechless.

It can obviously be taken to the next level.

Could it be that Lu Xue’s strength is really only tenth in the martial arts list?

This question appeared in everyone's hearts and could not be dissipated for a long time.

After all, it was already very powerful when I reached tenth place when I first fought on the martial arts list.

It would be a bit outrageous if I could rush forward.

Soon, the news that Lu Xue rushed to the tenth place in the martial arts list quickly spread throughout the academy.

Most people were shocked.

The first time I made the ranking, I reached tenth place, which is very rare.

A small number of people are a little suspicious.

"Is it only tenth?"

In the Huoyun Peak, Ye Yan sat cross-legged on the ground, and the three fairy fires around him were emitting the extreme high temperature.

He obviously didn't dare to accept the result of Lu Xue's attack on the martial arts list.

In his perception, how could a person who can collect the nine-clawed dragon as an immortal pet have only this strength?

Unless, the other party is a complete second generation of immortals.

"Senior brother, do you want to go and have a look?"

A Huoyun Peak disciple stood in front of Ye Yan and asked tentatively.

Hearing this, Ye Yan slowly looked into the distance, was silent for a moment, and said, "In your opinion, what do you think of that?"

"I?"

The Huoyun Peak disciple in front of Ye Yan obviously did not expect Ye Yan to ask him. After thinking for a while, he smiled and said, "He is pretty and looks very pleasing."

Ye Yan:...

"roll!"

"Oh, senior brother, be gentle!"

In a remote place in the academy, the yin energy is everywhere, and it looks very strange.

At this time, an illusory ghost floated towards him and finally stayed in front of a man.

His eyes are dark blue, which looks particularly creepy.

"Tenth? Is that the only thing?"

"Tsk, I'm a little disappointed."

The man waved his hand and the ghost in front of him suddenly dissipated.

Just as he sighed, a dull voice came from the distance, "Chu Lingsheng, don't say anything when he comes back, you kid are still so introverted."
